entries.ts: Mali ni nxaxamelo wa nhlayo
entries.ve: Mutengo na mutevhe wa vhunzhi

entries.english: No priced work can be listed yet: nothing has been drawn on the plan to measure. Draw the beds, tanks, fences and paths in the Design Studio and this bill fills itself from those measurements.
entries.zu: Akukho msebenzi onentengo ongafakwa ohlwini okwamanje: akukho okudwetshiwe epulanini okungalinganiswa. Dweba imibhede, amathangi, uthango nezindlela eSitudiyo somklamo bese lolu hlu lugcwaliswa ngalezo zilinganiso.
entries.st: Ha ho mosebetsi o nang le theko o ka ngolwang hajwale: ha ho letho le takilweng moralong le ka lekanngwang. Taka dibethe, ditanka, diterata le ditsela ho Studio sa moralo mme lenane lena le tla tlatswa ka ditekanyo tseo.
entries.ts: A ku si va na mitirho leyi nga ni nxavo leyi nga nxaxametiwaka: a ku na lexi dirowiweke eka pulani lexi nga pimiwaka. Dirowa mibedo, mathangi, marihlampfu ni tindlela eka Xitudio xa dizayini kutani nxaxamelo lowu wu ta tatiwa hi mimpimo yoleyo.
entries.ve: A hu athu vha na mushumo u re na mutengo u nga ṅwalwaho: a hu na tsho olwaho kha pulane tshi nga pimiwaho. Olani mibethe, thannga, mahura na nḓila kha Studio ya nyolo nahone mutevhe uyu u ḓo ḓadzwa nga mbonalo dzenedzo.

entries.english: Every quantity below is measured off this farm's own plan. Nothing here was estimated from a typical farm, and no line was added because a design "usually has one".
entries.zu: Bonke ubuningi obungezansi bulinganiswe epulanini laleli pulazi. Akukho okuqagelwe ngepulazi elivamile, futhi awukho umugqa ofakiwe ngoba umklamo "uvame ukuba nakho".
entries.st: Bongata bo bong le bo bong bo ka tlase bo lekantswe moralong wa polasi ena. Ha ho letho le hakantsweng ho tswa polasing e tlwaelehileng, mme ha ho mola o kentsweng hobane moralo "o atisa ho ba le wona".
entries.ts: Nhlayo yin'wana ni yin'wana laha hansi yi pimiwe eka pulani ya purasi leri. A ku na lexi ringanyetiweke hi ku ya hi purasi ra ntolovelo, naswona a ku na layini leyi engeteriweke hikuva dizayini "yi tala ku va na yona".
entries.ve: Vhunzhi vhuṅwe na vhuṅwe afho fhasi ho pimiwa kha pulane ya bulasi iḽi. A hu na tsho anganywaho u bva kha bulasi ḽo ḓoweleaho, nahone a hu na mutalo wo engedzwaho ngauri nyolo "i anzela u vha natsho".

entries.english: This subtotal is NOT the cost of the build. {unpriced} a measured quantity but no rate, so the real figure is higher by whatever those cost. They are listed above with the reason, rather than left out or costed at zero — a bill that hides what it could not price reads as complete when it is not.
entries.zu: Lesi samba AKUZONA izindleko zokwakha. {unpriced} ubuningi obulinganisiwe, kodwa intengo ngeyunithi ayikho; ngakho isibalo sangempela siphezulu ngezindleko zalezo zinto. Zifakwe ngenhla nezizathu zazo, azishiywanga ngaphandle noma zibizwe ngoziro — uhlu olufihla okungenantengo lubukeka luphelele kodwa lungaphelele.
entries.st: Kakaretso ena HA SE ditshenyehelo tsa kaho. {unpriced} bongata bo lekantsweng empa theko ka yuniti ha e yo, kahoo palo ya nnete e phahame ka ditshenyehelo tsa dintho tseo. Di thathamisitswe ka hodimo le mabaka a tsona, ho e na le ho siuwa kapa ho behwa theko ya lefela — lenane le patang seo le sa kang la se behela theko le bonahala le felletse empa le sa fella.
entries.ts: Ntsengo lowu A HI mali ya ku aka. {unpriced} nhlayo leyi pimiweke kambe nxavo hi yuniti a wu kona, kutani nhlayo ya xiviri yi le henhla hi mali ya swilo swoleswo. Swi nxaxametiwile laha henhla ni xivangelo xa swona, ematshan'weni yo swi siya kumbe ku swi veka eka ziro — nxaxamelo lowu tumbetaka leswi wu nga swi nyiki nxavo wu vonaka wu helele loko wu nga helelanga.
entries.ve: Mutengo uyu A SI mutengo wa u fhaṱa. {unpriced} vhunzhi ho pimiwaho fhedzi mutengo nga yuniti a u ho, ngauralo nomboro ya vhukuma i fhira nga mutengo wa zwithu zwenezwo. Zwo ṅwalwa afho nṱha na zwivhangi zwazwo, nṱhani ha u zwi sia kana u zwi vhea kha ziro — mutevhe u dzumbaho zwine wa si kone u zwi vhea mutengo u vhonala wo fhelela ngeno u songo fhelela.

entries.english: All prices are rough planning estimates based on late-2025/early-2026 South African retail pricing incl. VAT and will vary by region, supplier, and site access — get local quotes before committing budget.
entries.zu: Zonke izintengo ziyizilinganiso zokuqala zokuhlela ezisekelwe kumanani okuthengisa aseNingizimu Afrika ngasekupheleni kuka-2025/ekuqaleni kuka-2026, kuhlanganisa i-VAT, futhi zizohluka ngesifunda, umhlinzeki nokufinyeleleka kwendawo — thola amanani endawo ngaphambi kokuzibophezela ngebhajethi.
entries.st: Ditheko tsohle ke dikhakanyo tsa ho rera tse thehilweng dithekong tsa mabenkele tsa Afrika Borwa tsa mafelong a 2025/mathwasong a 2026, ho kenyeletsa VAT, mme di tla fapana ho ya ka sebaka, mofani le ho fihlelleha ha sebaka — fumana dikhotheishene tsa lehae pele o itlama ka tekanyetso.
entries.ts: Minxavo hinkwaya i mimpimanyeto yo pulana leyi sekeriweke eka minxavo ya mavhengele ya Afrika-Dzonga ya ekuheleni ka 2025/eku sunguleni ka 2026, ku katsa VAT, naswona yi ta hambana hi ndhawu, muxavisi ni ku ngheneka ka ndhawu — kuma minxavo ya laha kusuhi u nga si tiboha eka mpimanyeto.
entries.ve: Mitengo yoṱhe ndi ndinganyelo dza u pulana dzo ḓitikaho nga mitengo ya mavhengeleni ya Afurika Tshipembe ya mafheloni a 2025/mathomoni a 2026, hu katelwa VAT, nahone i ḓo fhambana nga dzingu, murengisi na u swikelea ha fhethu — wanani khotheisheni dza henefho musi ni sa athu ḓivhofha kha mugaganyagwama.

sourceNotes: BOQ no. is an item-count abbreviation; its native display uses a local word for count while SI units and values remain unchanged.
Existing summary drafts own authored bed/plot/listed-plant descriptions. Existing visual drafts own equipment, groups and known routes. Existing farmer-plan provenance draft is reused.
The native excluded-items fragments include their exclusion verb; English retains its original fragment plus excluded in the outer template.
